item.summary: fix(skills): add never-capture exclusions to autonomous self-learning prompts (#125716) Autonomous self-learning captured junk (transcript fragments, resolved transients, one-off narratives). The experience-review and history-scan prompts now carry an explicit never-capture exclusion list from one shared constant; user-invoked /learn intentionally keeps its own bar, protected by a negative prompt assertion. Operator-notice follow-up: #125723. Fixes #125710
